card.head: Your path to zero.
card.sub: A tour of Debt Payoff, on a made-up sample household.

scenes.say: Groundwork was built to help people get out of debt. Here's Debt Payoff, on a made-up sample household.
It starts with one date: the month you'll owe nothing, worked out from your real balances, rates and minimums.

scenes.do: _debtToggleWhatIf(); const r = document.getElementById('whatIfSlider'); r.value = 200; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true}));
scenes.last: const r = document.getElementById('whatIfSlider'); r.value = 200; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true}));
scenes.after: const r = document.getElementById('whatIfSlider'); r.value = 0; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); _debtToggleWhatIf();
scenes.say: Slide in a little extra each month, and watch the date move, and the interest you'd save add up.
Avalanche pays the highest rate first, and saves the most. Snowball clears the smallest balance first, for quicker wins. The choice is yours.
Every card and loan is listed with its balance, rate and minimum, and the month it's paid off on your plan.
When your imported transactions don't add up to the balance you typed, Groundwork shows both figures and asks. It never quietly replaces yours.
Each month, the tracker shows what goes to each debt, and marks each payment as it's confirmed.
The Advisor reads your own ledger and shows what would move your date the most, one change at a time, with the months and the interest each would save.

card.kicker: No loans to sell · No referral fees
card.head: Debt-free, on your own terms.
card.sub: Free for Windows, macOS and Linux · groundworkfinance.app

scenes.say: Groundwork never sells you a loan, a card or a consolidation offer. It shows you the math, and the choices stay yours. And it's free.
